mapper.sql: id, order_id, apply_user_id, apply_user_name, delay_reason, expected_time, status, approve_user_id, approve_time, approve_remark, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_delay_apply (order_id, apply_user_id, apply_user_name, delay_reason, expected_time, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{applyUserId}, #{applyUserName}, #{delayReason}, #{expectedTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_delay_apply WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.order_id, w.order_no, w.title AS summary, w.street_office, a.apply_user_name, a.delay_reason, a.expected_time, a.create_time, w.delay_count, w.deadline FROM order_delay_apply a JOIN dept_work_order w ON w.id = a.order_id WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.category = #{department} AND w.county_code = #{countyCode} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
